remarks: Discover your perfect retreat in this stunning Westport home, nestled in a coveted cul-de-sac. Whether you're looking for a furnished or unfurnished rental, this property provides unparalleled luxury and convenience. With 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full baths, this recently renovated residence boasts refinished hardwood floors, freshly painted interiors, and updated kitchen cabinetry.  Step outside to your private oasis-a fenced, in-ground heated pool with an automatic cover, perfect for enjoying the extended summer months. Additional high-end amenities include a whole-house generator, EV charging outlet, and a relaxing sauna. Stay connected with high-speed 1GB fiber internet included.  The open-concept design is ideal for both entertaining and everyday living, featuring a sunlit living room with a cozy fireplace, a kitchen with banquet seating, and a versatile dining/family area. The main level flows effortlessly to the patio, deck, and a charming playhouse. Upstairs, the king-size primary bedroom includes a spa-like bath, accompanied by two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. The lower level features a family room, another bedroom, and a sizable bath.  Perfectly situated within walking distance to town and local restaurants, and with tennis courts and baseball fields just across the street, this home is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts. Enjoy a bike ride to Compo Beach or Longshore for golf and pickleball.  Pets are welcome!
